scenes.text: You built a cooling centre. Can she use it?
It's open in the day. But her home stays hottest at night.
It's close. But she can't walk that far in the heat.
An alert went out. But she has no phone.
A ride there, and a neighbour who checks in, can make it reachable.
Who can use the protection you planned? Try the exercise at beat the heat dot Asia.
